# IntersectController

> Observes intersection visibility changes on the host, dispatching `native:intersect`.

## Constructor

```ts
new IntersectController(host: HTMLElement, options?: IntersectOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `threshold` | `number` | no |  |
| `root` | `string | null` | no |  |
| `margin` | `string` | no |  |
| `once` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:intersect` | `{ isIntersecting, ratio }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { IntersectController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new IntersectController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
